title: Data Compats (Create, BOP, Farmer's Delight)
description: A core datapack that homologates recipes, tags, and mechanics across 10+ major mods (Create, Farmer's Delight, BOP, Alex's Mobs, etc.) for a seamless and exploit-free modpack experience.
body:
⚙️ DataCompats / Mod Fixes & Compatibility

🛠️ Overview

DataCompats is a Datapack designed to repair, unify, and homologate mechanics across a highly modded environment. Its main goal is to ensure different mods interact with each other in a natural and balanced way.

Currently bridging compatibility between: Create, Biomes O' Plenty, Farmer's Delight, Galosphere, Alex's Mobs, Neapolitan, Cultural Delights, Some Assembly Required, Brewin' And Chewin', and Incubation.

Great for servers and modpack developers!

⚠️ Installation Guide

This is a DATAPACK! To use it globally as a Resource Pack, you need a mod like OpenLoader or GlobalPacks. Otherwise, place the .zip inside your world's datapacks folder.

🎯 Key Features & Tweaks

  • 🐒 Alex's Mobs & Neapolitan: Gelada Monkeys, Gorillas, and Chimpanzees now accept both types of bananas interchangeably. (I decided not to remove either banana type since they don't collide with each other).
  • ⚙️ Create + Cultural & Farmer's Delight: Automation integration. Crafted for the masses!
  • 💎 Create + BOP + Galosphere: Replaced and fixed the mechanics of Rose Quartz. This overhaul has also been applied to shards and Galosphere blocks.
  • 🍻 BOP + Brewin' and Chewin': Barley can now be used to make beer.
  • 🥒 Cultural Delights + Brewin' and Chewin': Cucumbers can now be fermented.
  • 🧪 BOP + Buzzier Beez: [WIP] Standardizing the potions that can be made with Clover.
  • 🥪 Some Assembly Required + WildBerries + Hexerei: Added the corresponding Jams and Jellies textures and integration for the sandwich system.
  • 🍳 Incubation + Farmer's Delight: Removed the redundant fried egg from Incubation to prevent recipe overlapping.
  • ⚔️ Iron's Bows Integration (bksp): Upgrade your bows and crossbows with Diamond and Emerald for increased durability and power.
  • 🏷️ Unified Tags: Ensures items from different mods are detected by global Forge tags.

💬 Feedback

I'm working hard on this and I've learned a lot! If there's any specific compatibility you want or need, please comment on this forum/page.
